description.en: Blastberry Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide increased defense and an additional attack in the form of lobbed projectiles that break into explosive bomblets.
description.zh: 爆莓藤蔓可以被种在其他植物身上，同时发射在半空中爆裂的榴弹，并向前弹射。

chat.en: Blastberry Vine snickers to himself. He imagines lobbing bomblets. He's been reading up on it and he knows it's gonna make a big splash when it happens. "Soon," he whispers.
chat.zh: 爆莓藤蔓暗自窃笑，他想象着自己投掷榴弹的场景。他已经研究了一阵子，深知一旦出手必将一鸣惊人。“让子弹飞一会，”他低语道。
